issues.title: Robots get funded, geotech goes digital, concrete goes round
issues.summary: Investors poured money into construction robotics this week, from ICON's 3D printers to Origin's wall-finishing robot. Hexagon is buying the geotechnical software house Rocscience to connect sensors with simulation, and recycled concrete got one of the biggest circular-economy rounds of the year. Our focus this week: what BIM really is, and why it is not yet a digital twin.
issues.focus_title: BIM is not a digital twin (yet)
